title.narrative: Investing for impact against Tuberculosis and HIV - South Africa (01-Oct-2025-31-Mar-2028)

description.narrative: South Africa, TB/HIV, Networking HIV and AIDS Community of Southern Africa NPC (NACOSA)This program has the following goals: Break down barriers to achieving solutions for HIV, TB and STIs.. Maximise equitable and equal access to services and solutions for HIV, TB and STIs.. Build resilient systems for HIV, TB and STIs that are integrated into systems for health, social protection, and pandemic response.. The objectives of this program are: Strengthen community-led responses to HIV/TB/STI to increase access to health services and improve health outcomes especially among key and vulnerable populations. Reduce new HIV infections by optimising the implementation of high-impact HIV-prevention intervention, especially among key & vulnerable priority populations such as high risk AGYW, ensuring the attainment of 3-95 among key and priority populations. Reduce stigma and discrimination, address gender inequalities to advance rights and access to services, protect and promote human rights and advance access to justice. Use timely and relevant strategic information for data-driven decision-making, including data based on community-led monitoring approach for action and use to improve health services
